title: Learning Roadmap
description: Build a step-by-step learning roadmap for any skill or topic based on your starting point and goal.
template:
Create a learning roadmap for [SKILL OR TOPIC].

Current level: [E.G. COMPLETE BEGINNER / BASIC FAMILIARITY / PRACTICAL EXPERIENCE]

Goal: [E.G. JOB-READY SKILLS / CONFIDENT PERSONAL USE / UNDERSTANDING FOR MANAGEMENT]

Time available: [E.G. 1 HOUR PER WEEK / 10 HOURS PER WEEK / INTENSIVE 4-WEEK PLAN]

Preferred learning style: [E.G. HANDS-ON PROJECTS / VIDEO COURSES / READING / TUTOR-LED]

Please provide:
1. **Milestones** — 3-5 major milestones from start to goal
2. **Ordered learning path** — What to learn first, second, third, and so on
3. **Resources per milestone** — Suggested types of resources, not exact links
4. **Practice activities** — Concrete exercises or projects for each milestone
5. **Checkpoints** — How to know when you are ready for the next milestone
example:
Create a learning roadmap for prompt engineering.

Current level: COMPLETE BEGINNER

Goal: USE PROMPTING CONFIDENTLY AT WORK

Time available: 5 HOURS PER WEEK

Preferred learning style: HANDS-ON PROJECTS

Please provide:
1. Milestones
2. Ordered learning path
3. Resources per milestone
4. Practice activities
5. Checkpoints
tips: Be honest about your starting point for a realistic roadmap
Add time estimates per milestone to make scheduling easier
Revisit the roadmap every 2-4 weeks and adjust based on what is working
